message: Unfortunately, Dick, it seems as if Quintilian might have been something of a spineless and sycophantic toady to despots: his fawning praise of the vicious Domitian may tell us more about rhetoric's relation to power than his borrowings from Cato. What would [Candidia](http://www.thehappytutor.com/archives/2004/07/candidia_cruiks.html) say?
